items.title: BJP counter-front: Piyush Goyal accuses Congress of 'undermining' ECI impartiality, says Congress 'politically rewarded' CECs
items.summary: At a BJP press conference in New Delhi on Tuesday, Union Minister Piyush Goyal accused the Congress of 'undermining the impartiality' of the Election Commission of India by 'politically rewarding' Chief Election Commissioners, Election Commissioners and electoral officers during the previous UPA government - citing T.N. Seshan being fielded on a Congress ticket against L.K. Advani (1999), M.S. Gill receiving the Padma Vibhushan as a sitting CEC (2000) before later joining Congress and becoming a Union Minister, two CECs appointed as Governors, and Naveen Chawla's elevation despite a removal recommendation. He asserted the NDA government under PM Modi has granted the ECI complete autonomy and never offered political benefits to ECs. First major same-day BJP counter-narrative presser amid the anti-CEC protests, Monday's INDIA bloc march and Tuesday's CJP re-detention.
